dct_title_s: Preliminary survey of Humboldt Bay, California
dct_description_sm: By the hydrographic party under command of Lieut. James Alden U.S.N. and Assist. U.S.C.S.
Relief shown by hachures; depths by soundings and isolines.
Inset map: Sketch of Humboldt Bay. Scale 1:150,000.
